exports.query:
select f.case_number, f.is_certified, f.annual_wage,
 coalesce(f.employer_id,'UNKNOWN') employer, coalesce(o.major_code,'UNKNOWN') soc_major,
 coalesce(f.soc_code,'UNKNOWN') soc,
 coalesce(case when g.cbsa_type='Metropolitan Statistical Area' then g.cbsa_code end,'UNKNOWN') metro,
 f.fiscal_year, f.employer_history_status
 from ANALYTICS.MARTS.fact_lca_case f left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation o using(occupation_key)
 left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_geography g using(geography_key)

select f.posting_id, f.observation_date, f.is_active,
 coalesce(f.employer_id,'UNKNOWN') employer, coalesce(o.major_code,'UNKNOWN') soc_major,
 coalesce(o.soc_code,'UNKNOWN') soc,
 coalesce(case when g.cbsa_type='Metropolitan Statistical Area' then g.cbsa_code end,'UNKNOWN') metro,
 d.fiscal_year, f.employer_mapping_status, f.occupation_mapping_status, f.geography_mapping_status
 from ANALYTICS.MARTS.fact_job_posting_daily f left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation o using(occupation_key)
 left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_geography g using(geography_key)
 left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_date d on f.observation_date_key=d.date_key

select f.soc_code soc, coalesce(o.major_code,'UNKNOWN') soc_major,
 case when f.area_type='4' then f.area_code else 'UNKNOWN' end metro,
 f.area_type||':'||f.area_code area, f.survey_year,
 cast(null as integer) fiscal_year, f.occupation_group occupation_level,
 g.geography_level, f.annual_median_wage, f.annual_median_wage_raw median_raw,
 f.wage_status, f.annual_flag, f.hourly_flag
 from ANALYTICS.MARTS.fact_wage_benchmark f left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_occupation o using(occupation_key)
 left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.dim_geography g using(geography_key)
